candidate.hypothesis: When a benchmark query exposes candidate answer phrases, deterministically ranking evidence slices that contain a complete query-provided phrase ahead of ordinary lexical matches will recover answer-bearing local evidence without inspecting gold labels. Queries without extractable candidate phrases retain the v7 lexical fallback.

query_phrase_policy.accepted_shape: a Python-literal list or tuple of at least two string options embedded in the query
query_phrase_policy.parser: ast.literal_eval over bounded bracket candidates; malformed or non-string structures fail closed to no phrases
query_phrase_policy.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, replace non-alphanumeric runs with one space, trim, and require at least two normalized tokens

candidate.ranking: Operation-bearing tombstone slices first. Then slices containing any complete normalized query-provided candidate phrase, ordered by number of distinct complete phrase hits; then query-token IDF lexical score; then source order and memory ID. Source-recency weight is exactly zero. Without at least two accepted phrases, ranking is exactly the v7 fallback.
candidate.storage: One atomic scientific-event batch per benchmark context; evaluation-only shadow storage; production index count remains zero.
candidate.production_promotion: No promotion is permitted during development or admission.

development_firewall.allowed: Only units and subjects whose frozen manifests label them development.
forbidden: all MemoryAgentBench validation and final units
all MemOps validation and final subjects
all v7 development gold values and expected outputs
all v7 selected-memory contents and model answers
development_firewall.permitted_v7_evidence: The v7 aggregate outcome, family-level effect counts, intervention coverage, runtime aggregate, and the observed mismatch between the local all-family substring scorer and official family-specific MemoryAgentBench metrics may guide v8. Per-case gold, expected outputs, answers, and selected evidence may not.

metric_governance.official_mapping_source: MemoryAgentBench repository README and configs at pinned code revision fe1735de8cf8b9908e1e3d3b5612afc815698062
metric_governance.note: The v8 MemoryAgentBench development gate contains only Accurate_Retrieval units, so one official family metric applies uniformly.

terminal_rule: Any failed development or admission gate is retained as failed_experiment_v8 or failed_admission_v8. Thresholds may not be relaxed and opened held-out evidence may never become tuning data.
claim_boundary: Only a full exact-SHA admission pass permits a bounded benchmark claim. SOTA, universal superiority, production promotion, replacement, 100%-pass, and revolutionary claims remain forbidden without separate external evidence.
